Subject: MAP Weekly: Marketplace close plan — reseller & marketplace steps

Team / partners — quick weekly MAP checkpoint. See updates below and two ask areas where we need concrete dates. I attached the latest MAP (MAP_v2.pdf) and a short procurement note extracted from Acme's RFP (procurement_notes.docx).

Quick status summary:
- MAP stage: Final procurement. Acme legal has one open clause on data residency; CS and Security are aligned on our standard language.
- Marketplace listing: AWS is in validation (expected listing start: target +10 business days) — Marcus please confirm. GCP listing in parallel but depends on resellers onboarding.
- Reseller onboarding: CloudChannel reroute for billing & invoicing; they need a signed reseller agreement and onboarding call.

Open blockers / asks (action items):
1) Marcus: confirm AWS listing ETA and whether any additional artifacts are required by Friday 07/02. Owner: marcus_lin.
2) Vanessa: confirm if we can accept CloudChannel invoicing on net-30 and provide a sample PO flow doc by 07/05. Owner: vanessa_ortiz.
3) Sergio: prepare a short note for Acme legal on our data residency controls (one page) and markups for the reseller section. Due 07/01. Owner: sergio_alvarez.
4) CloudChannel: please share the finalized reseller agreement (or DocuSign link) so Acme procurement can review alongside our MAP. Target 07/02.

Meeting cadence: keep weekly check-ins until close; propose next sync Thu 07/01 09:00 PT (calendar invite attached).

Attachments: MAP_v2.pdf (attached), procurement_notes.docx (attached)

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Hannah — quick update on AWS side and one dependency for GCP: 

- AWS: I confirmed with AWS Marketplace validation team. They need the signed reseller agreement only if we choose to route billing via CloudChannel; otherwise we can proceed under our direct seller profile. If we go direct, listing time drops to ~5 business days after we provide the final AMI + publisher assets. If we route through CloudChannel, validation extends to ~12 business days due to invoicing reconciliation.
- GCP: Marketplace onboarding requires CloudChannel to confirm reseller registration details (tax ID, billing address).

Action updates:  
- Marcus: will push to AWS to aim for direct listing and will share the final publisher checklist by EOD 07/02.
- Marcus: uploading a short publisher checklist to the MAP folder (will post link once available).
